algorithm.description: Deterministic, zero-dependency token counter pinned in scripts/token_analyzer.py. Any change to the caliber MUST bump version and go through decision.

threshold.note: Hard token-reduction gate REMOVED; reverses review-002 CR-004 (ACCEPTED). Reduction is now reported for visibility only. The acceptance gate (scripts/token_analyzer.py --compare) validates file completeness (no missing baseline/candidate files) + common.md reference integrity (every 'references/common.md §X.Y' resolves to a real heading in references/common.md) instead of a reduction percentage.

baseline.description: Restored pre-slim yy-spec-review framework prompt files (the thing being slimmed). Snapshot captured from git 45d26fa (before Plan B in-place slimming). Locked snapshot of scope; do NOT edit unless scope legitimately changes (then bump algorithm/manifest version).

candidate.description: Slimmed framework + references/common.md. The 13 live files above are replaced in place by their slimmed versions and references/common.md (new shared defs) is added and counted into the candidate total.
